name: Scourge of Baphomet

alignment.name: Chaotic Evil
alignment.description:
Chaotic evil creatures have a complete disregard for others. They kill, steal, and betray others to gain power. Their word is meaningless and their actions destructive. Their worldviews can be so warped that they destroy anything and anyone that doesn’t directly contribute to their interests.
	By the standards of good and lawful good people, chaotic evil is as abhorrent as evil, perhaps even more so. Chaotic evil monsters such as demons and orcs are at least as much of a threat to civilization and general well-being as evil monsters are. An evil creature and a chaotic evil creature are both opposed to good, but they don’t have much respect for each other either and rarely cooperate toward common goals.
	For the purpose of game effects, a chaotic evil creature is also considered evil.

description: This is the size of a typical human and serves as a standard in the game. This category has no special rules.
